Class EpistemicEdge

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Edge
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.EpistemicEdge
All Implemented Interfaces:
Commented, Comparable<EpistemicEdge>
public class EpistemicEdge extends Edge implements Comparable<EpistemicEdge>
An epistemic edge models what a character believes a node's state to be. The tail node is the actual state. The label is a character. The head node is the state the character believes to be the case.

New epistemic edges should be created in a story graph using the EpistemicEdgeList.add(Node, Character, Node) method.

Author:
Stephen G. Ware

      Description copied from class: Edge
      Removes any pruned elements from this element, and if this element itself should be pruned its ID number will be set to Settings.PRUNED.

      An edge will be pruned if its tail node, label, or head node have their ID numbers set to Settings.PRUNED.
